parsed.answer: Use POST /oauth/revoke to revoke (invalidate) an access token before it expires. Authenticate with clientBasic (HTTP Basic). Send a form-encoded body (application/x-www-form-urlencoded) with the required field "token" set to the access token to act on. A 200 response means the token was revoked; the call succeeds with an empty body even if the token was already invalid. A 401 response indicates the access token is missing, invalid, or expired (Problem code AUTH-001).
